integrity: The proof is self-contained after the standard injective-tensor/operator identification and uses exact finite-dimensional norm and rank-one formulas. No numerical experiment is used as proof. The focal full text and the closest published comparison statement were checked at the implication level.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to canonical injective tensor products of finite-dimensional classical sequence spaces with both dimensions at least two. It does not classify extremizers or arbitrary finite-dimensional Banach factors.
title: All finite-dimensional classical injective \(\ell_p\)-tensor products have maximal von Neumann--Jordan constant
